details.description: Mistral Large 3 is Mistral AI's flagship open-weight model, released December 2, 2025 under an Apache 2.0 license. It uses a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 41B active and 675B total parameters, including a vision encoder for image understanding, and a 256K-token context window. It supports native function calling, JSON output and strong system-prompt adherence for agentic and enterprise use. Mistral AI states it performs best among open-weight models on multilingual conversations outside English and Chinese, and a dedicated reasoning variant was announced as coming soon but was not yet released at launch.
advantages: Combines a 41B active / 675B total parameter sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture with a 2.5B-parameter vision encoder for multimodal image understanding (Hugging Face model card).
Debuted at #2 among open-weight non-reasoning models (#6 among all open-weight models) on the LMArena leaderboard at launch (Mistral AI launch post).
Supports native function calling and JSON output with strong system-prompt adherence (Hugging Face model card).
Mistral AI reports best-in-class performance among open-weight models on multilingual conversations outside English and Chinese (Mistral AI launch post).
Supports English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Arabic (Hugging Face model card).
disadvantages: A dedicated reasoning version was described as 'coming soon' at launch, so this instruct release does not have a reasoning mode (Mistral AI launch post).
use_cases: Agentic tool use via native function calling

notes: Mistral AI's docs give a 256K-token (262,144) context window for this model, matching the catalog's facts exactly. The docs overview page lists Mistral Large 3 (v25.12) as a current, non-deprecated model with no retirement date. No numeric benchmark score (0-100, higher-is-better) was published for this exact model at research time; the LMArena result found is a leaderboard rank/Elo-style placement, not an accuracy score, so it is described in advantages rather than listed under evaluations. The Mistral AI launch post did not give exact benchmark figures for Large 3 itself, only qualitative claims and the LMArena placement.
